title: AcademicPeriod
description: Institutional academic interval such as year, semester, quarter, or term.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

version.description: Starts at 1. Increment exactly once per authoritative mutation.

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest authoritative mutation. Server assigned.

parent_id.description: Enclosing period in the same institution, if any.

code.description: Institution-wide stable catalog and reporting key.

ends_before.description: Exclusive civil date. Must follow starts_on.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for civil date boundaries.

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Mutate only through declared transitions.

x-invariants: Child window is contained within parent. Overlapping sibling periods are allowed for concurrent tracks.
Changing a period does not rewrite existing offering deadlines, published schedules, or report revision snapshots.
Closed period may be reopened with evidence and dual approval when official reports exist.
